newsitem.title: UK: TABLE--UK BRC JULY RETAIL SALES SURVEY.
newsitem.headline: TABLE--UK BRC JULY RETAIL SALES SURVEY.

text.p: The British Retail Consortium published the following data on UK retail sales value in July (annual percentage changes):

NOTE - The retail sales monitor is based on responses from retailers accounting for around half of total UK retail sales. The retailers contributing to the survey complete weekly sales returns on sales values, in five retail categories.
The latest responses for July cover the four week to August 2, in line with the period covered by the Office for National Statistics.

The BRC says like-for-like figures in general provide a more accurate guide to spending patterns, removing the effect of any expansion in retail floor space in sales, thus ignoring the effect of sales taken from retailers out of the sample.

The like-for-like figures generally will be biased downwards as an estimate of the true growth rate, although the relationship between official estimates of sales growth and the like-for-like increase does fluctuate from month to month, the BRC said.
